**Chinese name:** 普冉半导体（上海）股份有限公司 (Pǔrǎn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The textbook double-case of 2025-26 fabless China: buying a distressed global asset to jump product tiers (SHM = ex-SK Hynix 2D NAND carve-out, world #4 SLC NAND — the 51% cash purchase closed November 2025 and the ¥23.46亿 H1 consolidated contribution proves the thesis), then riding the AI memory supercycle — H1 2026 revenue ¥39.59亿 (+336.7%) and net ¥8.27亿 (+1930%), versus FY2025 ¥23.20亿/+28.6% with profit down. The remaining 49% (¥2.47bn in shares+convertibles+cash) goes to the SSE's M&A restructuring committee on 14 October 2026, the clearest near-term test of how domestic consolidation deals clear review. Its MCP modules already ship into HP/Motorola/Cisco/Bosch chains.
:::

## What does this firm design?

NOR/EEPROM/SLC-NAND/eMMC/MCP memory and general/motor MCUs, camera VCM/OIS drivers.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2016 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | NOR flash (global #5, 550M+ units 2025), EEPROM (leader in phone-camera VCM), MCUs, VCM/OIS drivers; SLC NAND/eMMC/MCP via the SHM acquisition |
| **Node Sophistication** | 40nm/4x-nm specialty NOR+MCU (2nd-gen SONOS, 3rd-gen '40E' in production); mature-node capacity scarcity (SMIC/Hua Hong) is its stated pricing driver |
| **Entity List** | No |
